dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high degree of falcation starting from the upper third of the fin, forming a pronounced inward curve.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex characterized by a smooth, non-acute pixel curve at the point of maximum elevation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin maintains a mostly linear slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Visible base-to-height ratio is approximately 1.3:1 based on the visible pixel boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily notched trailing edge with multiple irregular serrations and a prominent V-shaped indentation at the basal margin. Scattered depigmented epidermal marks are visible on the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive jagged, saw-tooth profile along the entire posterior edge of the dorsal fin.
